name: Heibai Dushi de Yinmi Lian Qu
source:
A uniquely-styled text adventure game. The protagonist wakes up in a mysterious city after death, only to learn that every soul is granted one chance at reincarnation. But his missing death memory haunts him with endless doubts.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4201490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款风格独特的文字冒险游戏。主角在死后于一座神秘都市中醒来，得知每个灵魂都能获得一次转世重生的机会；然而缺失的死亡记忆，却令他陷入无尽的疑云之中。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4201490/]Steam[/url]]
